exposure: need to entrust a newborn (NEN) in the care of maternity rooming-in staff
Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
Need to entrust newborn (NEN) in the care of maternity rooming-in staff
cohort: 200 adult women in the maternity ward operating in the rooming-in system
finding: Women who felt the need to entrust their newborn in the care of maternity rooming-in staff had higher levels of pain, state anxiety, and postpartum anxiety than women without this need.
mod_finding: The need to entrust newborn (NEN) was higher for women after a caesarean section than for women after vaginal delivery on both days of the study.
